name: nigel payne
headline: Director Of Business Development at Oracle
about:
I have been privileged to work for two very large world-class organisations where I have developed a deep and wide understanding of many aspects of business. I have thrived on challenging environments and the need for change. My main interests and, indeed, activities have been in fast-paced environments. Starting life off in delivery, moving through to business development and eventually sales, enabled me to get a good understanding of the overall challenges organizations have in getting products and services to market successfully.
Having completed 25 years working for corporates, I have now taken the opportunity to work with two smart entrepreneurs to establish a world-class audio electronics manufacturing company.
Specialties: Sales, P&L Management, Management of Change, Outsourcing and Managed Services
… more

experiences.description: Responsible for growth of Managed Cloud Services business across EMEA.

A high-end audio electronics company focusing on proactive acoustic, EMI and RF noise reduction techniques to ensure that the digital and analogue electronics are free from the disruptive nature of these effects.  This technology ensures that tracking errors in audio reproduction are minimised and, as a result, unprecedented musical performance is achieved.

experiences.position: MEA Leader and Installed Base Sales Leader
experiences.description: Managed the Oracle Managed Cloud Services business for Middle East and Africa for 4 years.  Resulting growth from a zero dollar business has been 34% YoY with a multi-million Dollar business for Oracle in this region.  Major team wins including largest EMEA deal in 2013.  First new customers in Kuwait, South Africa and Qatar.

Established the offshore installed base sales team for the Oracle Managed Cloud Services EMEA business.  This included managing a pan-EMEA team of Sales Professionals who were responsible for the ongoing relationship with existing customers.  All Sales KPIs were up as a result of this team and their efforts with the business continue to grow and be supported by passionate and determined people.

Responsible for managing New Business Growth within the On Demand EMEA sales team.  Ran the pipeline and deal review process to allow for effective targeting of opportunities and prioritisation of resources.  Win rates increased from 18% to 34% with business growing in excess of 40% per year.

Responsible for ensuring that profitability is a focus in order to ensure On Demand is a viable business in its own right.  Developed a change management programme for the Delivery organization to be better equipped and aware of how to maintain strong customer satisfaction during organization change.  Cascaded a profit and loss culture throughout the entire organization.  Also negotiated and signed a major partnering agreement with a large telco in order to complete the delivery value proposition for On Demand in EMEA.

After a successful roll-out of a company-wide proposal generation system and process, I took on the role of driving an effective risk management approach to our deals.  To many individuals, the idea of risk and how to manage it was to avoid it all costs.  The challenge here was to drive a methodology (supported by software) on how to identify, quantify, determine threat in terms of probability and impact and, most importantly, how to manage risk.  This methodology was particularly important for large outsourcing engagements where many different facets of the deals would lead to many unknowns or new areas where HP would need to enter and develop expertise.

Bid Manager for HP's Outsourcing Services.  Prime responsibility for a $multi-million P&L, delivery model, drive sales momentum through country structures.  Assisted in sales pursuits through executive meetings.  Developed the Line of Business model used as the blueprint for Managed Services and eventually encouraged the change to absorb into the Infrastucture Management portfolio.
Consultative solution selling of test and measurement products with prime objective of achieving a $multi-million annual quota.
